The final straight of the Victoria Mile. 
Vodka displayed phenomenal acceleration, 
sending the venue into an uproar.

Vodka is thrilled and captivated by how 
cool it is to blow past all the other 
Umamusume in an instant.

Vodka determined that this explosive 
sprint was the very weapon she had been 
searching for. To polish it to absolute 
perfection, she sets her sights on the 
Yasuda Kinen!
